title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC equity — willed Adam to bear our person in sinning, not in being punished
pass_a_gloss: Placeus presses the equity crack: God is made to will that Adam carry our person at the moment of the act, yet refuse that the same Adam still carry our person when the punishment falls.
pass_b_english: Seeing that he willed Adam to sustain our person when Adam sinned, but did not will that same man to sustain our person when Adam was punished.
source_text: Quippe qui voluerit Adamum sustinere personam nostram cum peccavit, non voluerit autem nostram personam eundem sustinere cum punitus est.

choices.choice: Person sustained in sinning, not in punishment
